ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low internal contrast on the fluke surface; dominant low-intensity (dark) pixels with a ratio of approximately 98:2 relative to high-intensity (white) specular highlights from water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity (black/dark-grey) contiguous region across both lobes. Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters are observed primarily as reflections along the ventral-distal margins and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 45 degrees, centered symmetrically between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical serration profile: the left lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, jagged micro-peaks at the distal end, while the right lobe trailing edge exhibits a smoother, low-amplitude undulating topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the mid-lobe, and ending in a sharp, tapered distal tip on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of high-intensity white circular pixels concentrated at the extreme distal tip of the left lobe, consistent with barnacle scar patterns.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are clearly visible on the central-upper surface of the right lobe, featuring both vertical and diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the right lobe; irregular edge erosion and minor notches on the distal portion of the left lobe trailing edge.
